notes.title: Crossplay and Samurai are Here!!! New FREE UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 Galaxy Kart Update Alert! 🎉[/h1]

Gear up, racers! 🏎️ Our latest Galaxy Kart update brings even more action and excitement to the track. Here’s what’s new:

[img]https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974638_553486720770527_3018598602347351676_n.jpg?stp=dst-jpg_q92_s2048x2048&_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qijp_MFsSo8Q7kNvgExmOlc&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBlFwWZovPf8woizsW7itcB_0PsNMKemtdPbi7-JKicaw&oe=67304424[/img]

[h2]🌸 Meet Tomoe, the Samurai 🌸[/h2]
Our newest character joins the fray, armed with a powerful blade that sends energy waves, stunning any racer in her path! Master her moves and watch your competition tremble.

[h2]🎯 New Training Mode 🎯[/h2]
Hone your skills and get race-ready! With our all-new Training Mode, you can practice power-ups, sharp turns, and perfecting your laps without the heat of competition. Whether you're a new driver or a pro, this mode’s here to help you dominate.

[h2]🌐 Crossplay Multiplayer Now Supported! 🌐[/h2]
Grab your friends on PSVR2, Meta Quest, or SteamVR for the ultimate multiplayer experience. Connect, compete, and conquer the galaxy together—no matter what platform you're on!

Are you ready to take your racing skills to the next level? Jump in and feel the thrill! 🏆

#GalaxyKart #VRGaming #TomoeSamurai #TrainingMode #Crossplay

notes.title: Patch Notes | 1.00.10 | Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Galaxy Kart VR Patch Notes | 1.00.10[/h1][/b]

Hello everyone! After collecting your feedbacks, we've prepared a Hotfix for you in order to fix some of the major issues our players have been experiencing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38918041/222586f86c3a98b6a7eb6348f512eebfbf4697ce.png[/img]

[h2]Hotfix details:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hotfix details:
[*] Multiplayer crashes fixed;
[*] Hands now disappear if controllers are not moving (great addition for Steering Wheel users!);
[*] Improved content Unlock messages (players can now more easily find information on how to unlock each content/what they have unlocked); 
[*] And other bugfixes 🛠️
[/list]

Thank you so much for playing and for giving us so much support! 🚀

If you have any feedback and/or issue with Galaxy Kart, come join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/PFcTv3nRSt]here[/url] and talk directly to our team!

notes.title: Galaxy Kart VR Steam Release
notes.notes:
[b]Galaxy kart[/b], an arcade [b]VR [/b]Kart racing game focused on combat and the use of individual skill of each driver is releasing on Steam on [b]October 12th[/b]! Prepare yourself to this unforgettable competition!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38918041/666767f61cbf1f0d1f68e773c13204497cabca8a.png[/img]

[i]Hello, racers! Are you ready to jump into this crazy adventure? 🏆[/i]

[h1]Galaxy Kart VR Steam Release consists of:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Full game release + demo
[*] 9 playable characters and karts, each one with your own different skill;
[*] 6 unique tracks;
[*] Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes (up to 6 players)!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38918041/6845412ecfc172518367ecb073789729169a8735.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]What is Galaxy Kart VR?[/b][/h2]
In a Galaxy full of crazy pilots, a frantic championship around numerous galaxies and world scenarios decides who's the best racer of all times! Galaxy Kart VR is an arcade kart racing game, focused on combat and on the use of each hero's individual abilities. To win the race, players can use their own unique skills, depending on the character they choose. Also, different items can be collected along the way to annoy enemies. 

[i]Fasten your seat belts and get ready to the race! 🏁[/i]

[h3][b]Watch here a sneak peek of what's coming:[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=MiMH8BC9YSU;full][/previewyoutube]
